prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square food illustration for a family meal-selection app.
Primary request: a small ceramic plate with scrambled eggs and two triangular slices of toasted bread.
Style: polished editorial gouache food illustration, appetising and clearly recognisable at thumbnail size, softly painted natural colour, precise silhouette, restrained texture. Adult cookbook quality, not a cartoon mascot.
Composition: directly overhead, single dish centred, complete plate visible with generous clear margin, square canvas. Consistent simple ivory ceramic tableware.
Background: uniform pale warm ivory #fffdf8, no table scene.
Constraints: only the named dish, no utensils, hands, people, text, labels, logos or watermarks. No interface or card frame.
